title: Farm Real Estate Loans Servicing Fee Schedule: Late Charges, Courtesy Waivers and Returned Payments
content:
These servicing fees apply to the six FarmLand products of Farm Real Estate Loans. The terms mean:

- **Late-charge percentage** — the late charge on an installment still not fully paid after the grace period, as a percentage of the unpaid installment.
- **Minimum late charge and maximum late charge** — the least and the most one late charge may be, in USD.
- **Grace period** — the calendar days after an installment's due date before a late charge arises.
- **Courtesy waivers per 12 months** — the late charges that may be waived as a courtesy per loan in any rolling 12 months.
- **Returned payment fee** — the fee per returned payment, in USD.

## Schedule

| Product | Late-charge % | Minimum late charge (USD) | Maximum late charge (USD) | Grace period (calendar days) | Courtesy waivers per rolling 12 months | Returned payment fee (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 4.0 | 50 | 1500 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 4.0 | 50 | 1500 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 4.0 | 50 | 1500 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 4.0 | 75 | 2000 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.0 | 75 | 2000 | 15 | 1 | 30 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 4.0 | 100 | 2500 | 15 | 0 | 30 |

## Reading the schedule

- The late-charge percentage (4.0) and the grace period (15 calendar days) are the same on every FarmLand product; the bounds widen with the longer fixed products.
- The FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage allows no courtesy waiver of a late charge (0 per rolling 12 months); every other product allows one.
- The returned payment fee is USD 30 on every product.
